content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides a D5-vs-C5 link collision by separating the challenger's wording answer from the defender's application answer rather than treating the pressed witnesses as a chain collision.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'never verse by verse' — I weighed whether splitting 'virgin and young-woman wording' from 'prophetic application' is a forbidden point-by-point handling of a chain collision or a permissible finding that the chains do not meet.","why":"The judge declares the link underdetermined by separating the challenger's word-level answer from the defender's application answer instead of weighing the competing chains by footing as K-C requires."}
